draft.title: Purposes of remedies
card: A remedy is what a court orders to deal with a wrong in a civil dispute. The person who sued is the plaintiff.
the main aim is to put the plaintiff back in the position they were in before the wrong, as far as money or an order can do this.
another aim is to stop the wrong continuing, so that the harm to the plaintiff does not go on or happen again.
A court looks at the harm in the case and picks a remedy that suits it. Some wrongs are in the past and some are still going on.
draft.remember: A remedy puts the plaintiff back where they were, or stops the wrong carrying on.

a.q: What is the main purpose of a remedy in a civil dispute?
opts: To put the plaintiff back in their earlier position
To make the defendant pay a fine to the state
To decide whether the defendant is guilty of a crime
To make sure the plaintiff ends up better off than before
a.why: A remedy aims to restore the plaintiff to where they were before the wrong. Making them better off is tempting, but the aim is to restore, not to give a gain. Fines and guilt belong to criminal cases.
a.clue: Think about where the plaintiff stood before the wrong happened.

b.q: Priya's neighbour Tom keeps running a loud machine at night in Geelong, and it still disturbs her sleep. Which purpose of a remedy fits her need most directly?
opts: Stopping the wrong from continuing
Restoring her to her position before the wrong
Showing the court thought little of her claim
Recording that the wrong happened in the past
b.why: The wrong is still going on, so the most direct need is to stop it continuing. Restoring her position is also a purpose, but it deals with harm already done. The other options are not purposes of remedies on the card.
b.clue: Is the wrong over, or is it still happening?

a.best: To put the plaintiff back in their earlier position

problems.detail: The clue ('Think about where the plaintiff stood before the wrong happened') points straight at the only option about the plaintiff's earlier position, so a student can pick it without knowing the idea.
